breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal axial force as uniform along the entire bar, even though point loads make the axial force piecewise constant with jumps at the loading points.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the internal axial force as piecewise constant with jumps at each loading point (F_AB = 22000 N, F_BC = 4000 N, F_CD = 16000 N), rather than as a single uniform force along the entire bar. It explicitly uses free-body cuts at each segment to determine the distinct internal forces.

breakdown.description: The prompt reduces the problem to one net-load stress state, which conflicts with the need to resolve different internal forces and displacements segment by segment.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification resolves the problem segment by segment, computing separate stresses (73.33 MPa, 13.33 MPa, 53.33 MPa) and separate deformations for each segment, then summing them to get the total displacement. It does not reduce the problem to a single net-load stress state, fully aligning with the ground truth approach.
